names.why: Not a phantom, but not a quarterly earnings print either: Innate Pharma's own 2026 financial calendar schedules publication of the HALF-YEAR financial statements on 2026-09-17, and a second company release confirms an H1 2026 results conference call that day — it is a semi-annual French reporter whose only other interim disclosures are Q1 and Q3 revenue-and-cash updates.
names.session_evidence: The company's financial calendar states all reports are released before the market opens CET, and the H1 call is 2:00 p.m. CEST / 8:00 a.m. EDT on 2026-09-17 — the release therefore precedes the US open by hours, so bmo on 09-17 is correct. https://www.innate-pharma.com/media/all-press-releases/innate-pharma-releases-its-2026-financial-calendar and https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/innate-pharma-to-host-conference-call-and-webcast-on-september-17-for-first-half-2026-financial-results-and-business-update
where_to_look: Read the Euronext Paris release (IPH.PA) not the ADS wire: the French H1 document is the fuller one and is published before the US open, so the US-listed ADS reprices into an already-traded Paris session — check the Paris move first

For a clinical-stage biotech the H1 release is mostly a CASH RUNWAY statement: find the stated runway end-date and compare it with the runway given in the 2026-05-13 Q1 cash update and the March 2026 FY25 statements — a shortened runway is the single most repriceable line

Partner-controlled value: check AstraZeneca's and Sanofi's own disclosures and pipeline pages for the status of the monalizumab / IPH5201 / IPH5301 programmes and any milestone recognition, since the revenue line is largely partner-driven
Clinicaltrials.gov record changes (enrolment status, primary completion dates, terminated arms) for the lead assets since May — registry edits precede press releases
AMF/Euronext regulated-information filings and any capital-increase or ATM authorisation from the May 2026 AGM: at a ~$208m cap with a 50% realised vol, financing risk is the live question
There is no options market on the ADS and average volume is ~25k shares — capacity is minimal and any measured 'move' is fragile; weigh that before sizing anything

The conference-call announcement for 2026-09-17 at 14:00 CEST / 08:00 EDT with the named speakers

names.history_warning: The baseline's eight 'prior prints' on an inferred 8-day cadence are 6-K text matches, not earnings — a semi-annual reporter cannot print eight times in three months. They are press releases and operational/regulatory 6-Ks (the 2026-08-10 +28.3% move in particular is almost certainly a news event, not a results reaction). Do not inherit median_abs_move 2.97% or the 3-up-of-8 base rate as an earnings prior; the true earnings base rate is two events a year.

Everything fundamental lives in the LEN dossier — do not re-research the quarter here
